this_record_executes_nothing: THIS FILE RUNS NOTHING AND AUTHORISES NOTHING YET. It freezes interpreter, cwd, argv and hashes so that, if the architect later sends GO, exactly one known command can be invoked. It is not a licence to execute.

authorisation_state.what_unlocks_it: an explicit GO from the architect, in a later turn
authorisation_state.user_instruction_verbatim: L'authorization deve congelare interpreter/cwd/argv/hash ma non e' licenza di esecuzione finche' non ti invio GO

scope_of_this_turn.verbatim: prepara, testa e preregistra J11; NON ESEGUIRE IL FIT e NON CREARE IL LEAF REALE

what_would_be_authorised.description: one invocation of the frozen J11 runner: materialise the 24713-row aggregate, fit the six direct mean-network tensors from the J2 parent, apply the binding offline gate and commit the single frozen leaf
what_would_be_authorised.retry: NONE. Whatever the outcome there is no second attempt, no alternate leaf, no changed argument and no autonomous recovery.
what_would_be_authorised.parallel_subagents: permitted for READ-ONLY audit work only; the fit itself is SINGLE

operational_parent.role: the weights this fit starts from. J8 is a sibling fit, never an ancestor.

observation_contract_ancestor.what: the 39-wide August V26 imitative actor under which the J10R1 teacher cells were collected. NOT a weight ancestor and never loaded here.
observation_contract_ancestor.why_recorded: the two hashes are easy to conflate; they are kept distinct throughout

frozen_execution.progress_flag: --progress is OPTIONAL and changes nothing but stdout; adding it is the only permitted variation and it may equally be omitted
frozen_execution.output_root_override: MUST BE UNSET. The runner refuses a real fit into a redirected root.
frozen_execution.no_other_flag: no other flag may be added, removed or altered
frozen_execution.capture: stdout, stderr and the exit code are captured fail-closed to files; capture is redirection only and cannot cause a second attempt

immediately_before_any_execution.recheck_the_frozen_hashes: byte-for-byte against both hash maps above
immediately_before_any_execution.recheck_j10r1: its commit_verification must still declare pass true and no TECHNICAL_INVALID marker may be present
immediately_before_any_execution.rerun_the_preflight: must be GO, with no blockers and torch absent from sys.modules
immediately_before_any_execution.reconfirm_absence: no J11 leaf, no lock, no staging, no sentinel
immediately_before_any_execution.on_any_mismatch: DO NOT EXECUTE. Stop and report.

gate_fail.expected_state: the leaf IS COMMITTED with the full evidence, the post-commit verification PASSES and the verdict is FAIL; exit non-zero
gate_fail.action: PRESERVE, write the phase report, STOP and diagnose. No retry.

post_commit_verification_failure.expected_state: the leaf is PRESERVED, carries commit_verification.json with pass false and the TECHNICAL_INVALID marker; exit non-zero
post_commit_verification_failure.meaning: a statement about the COMMIT, never about the fit
post_commit_verification_failure.action: PRESERVE. No deletion, no repair, no retry.

technical_error.expected_state: NO leaf is committed; staging and lock removed

pass.expected_state: the leaf is committed, commit_verification declares pass true, the marker is gone and the verdict is PASS; exit 0
pass.action: PRESERVE, write the phase report, hand back to the architect
pass.confers_nothing: a PASS produces a fitted actor. It authorises no closed-loop qualification, no critic, no PPO, no promotion and no next stage.

validity_rule: a committed J11 leaf is VALID EVIDENCE if and only if commit_verification.json exists inside it and declares pass true
a_pass_does_not_authorise: the closed-loop qualification of this actor
any change to FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA or the C++ plugin
this_authorisation_does_not: permit execution before an explicit architect GO
modify the runner, the preregistration or the tests
modify any J0-J10R1 artefact, July source, report or production configuration
grant a second attempt under any circumstance
permit a different leaf, interpreter, cwd or argv
